svg.title: ADBC in the browser: use your existing drivers
svg.desc: Haybarn and Cupola use the WebAssembly build of the Grainlift ADBC driver. vgi-rpc carries requests over HTTP and Arrow results back to the browser. A Grainlift gateway on your computer or server loads an existing native ADBC driver, which connects to its database. PostgreSQL and DuckDB are two examples.

g.aria-label: Keep the driver native. Bring the results to the browser.
